rationale: Forty chronic-kidney-disease patients were assigned functional foods, exercise, both or usual care; foods included extra-virgin olive oil in fruit/vegetable bars with grape pomace, seeds and olive leaf. Physical testing and body composition reflect a bundle, not isolated olive oil or Parkinson walking. PMID39064768 / PMC11279472.

Aged rats received a mixture of olive oil, algae oil and olive leaf extract; outcomes included sarcopenia-related tissue changes, not an isolated olive-oil intervention or clinical Parkinson gait. PMID34356299 / PMC8301163.

Pediatric atopic dermatitis trial tested topical coconut- and sunflower-derived isosorbide diesters in oatmeal cream; sleep collected but route, derivatized ingredient, patient group and outcome differ from oral virgin coconut oil and Parkinson daytime sleepiness. PMID41598765 / PMC12842038.

Endometriosis randomized trial reports flax intervention reduced pelvic pain and dysmenorrhea versus cellulose; article inconsistently calls it flaxseed oil and describes flaxseeds, with oil processing unspecified. Resolve original formulation and registry IRCT20190625044004N1 before asserting isolated oral oil or assessing 0639. PMID39759908 / PMC11694585.
